description: Staff-recorded consent is not resident account agreement acceptance. Pending requests do not reserve. Accept creates allocation+immutable invoice+audit+outbox atomically; minimum0 confirmed without payment receipt. Future price/room or expiry requires refresh with new consent. No payment verification/proof/check-in API here. Internal worker processes expiry and in-app; customer transactional business email not configured.
